gloss: school report sent with an application

definitions.gloss: school report sent with an application
definitions.explanation: A confidential record of a student's grades, attendance, activities and conduct, prepared by the student's school and sent to the school they apply to. It matters most for entrance to high school.

examples.japanese: {内申書|ないしんしょ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧だ。
{内申書|ないしんしょ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{成績|せいせき}→成績：03379_seiseki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上|あ}げたい→上げる：02443_ageru⟧。
examples.english: I want to raise my grades on the school report.

examples.japanese: ⟦{公立|こうりつ}→公立：08210_kouritsu⟧⟦{高校|こうこう}→高校：01083_koukou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{入試|にゅうし}→入試：04705_nyuushi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{当日|とうじつ}→当日：04558_toujitsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧⟦だけでなく→〜だけでなく：18373_dakedenaku⟧{内申書|ないしんしょ}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{合否|ごうひ}→合否：31721_gouhi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: In public high school entrance exams, the school report affects admission as well as the exam on the day.

notes:
The official name is {調査書|ちょうさしょ}. The grade points on it are ⟦{内申点|ないしんてん}→内申点：08608_naishinten⟧, often shortened to {内申|ないしん}.
